name: HQ design system (Rin's charter)
summary: The CEO's audit was correct: HQ's visual language was inherited from the game's cozy theme, not derived from how to communicate data. This project rebuilds it deliberately. Shipped so far: pills mark exceptions only; status is CSS-drawn, hue reserved for semantics; referenced things always resolve (link + age + owner, never bare prose mentions); a 12px type floor and tabular numerals; decorative emoji pruned from data surfaces (kept as identity avatars); the brief maintains itself with zero user controls.
requirements: One documented type scale (~5 steps) replacing the ~14 ad-hoc sizes
Color = semantics: one hue per meaning; brand gold separated from attention amber
Contrast pass: all text meets readable thresholds on the dark ground
Trend charts where the question is 'compared to what': commit-velocity sparklines per pillar, wasted-% across playtest sessions against the ruled 12% bar, benchmark over runs
Emoji policy written down: identity avatars yes, decoration no, status never
Every HQ page passes Rin's review against the system
current_status: Structural tranche shipped with the landing-page rework. Remaining: the type-scale consolidation, the gold/amber hue split, contrast audit, the three trend charts, and the org-chart re-envisioning below.
